subject: Ciências
description_pt: Explorar fenômenos da vida cotidiana que evidenciem propriedades físicas dos materiais – como densidade, condutibilidade térmica e elétrica, respostas a forças magnéticas, solubilidade, respostas a forças mecânicas (dureza, elasticidade etc.), entre outras.

components.description_pt: Identificar propriedades físicas mensuráveis como dureza, cor, densidade e condutividade para classificar materiais
components.description_en: Identify measurable physical properties such as hardness, color, density, and conductivity used to classify materials

components.description_pt: Relacionar propriedades físicas de um material ao seu uso apropriado em objetos cotidianos
components.description_en: Relate the physical properties of a material to its appropriate use in everyday objects
components.cc_component_description: Select appropriate materials for a design based on their physical properties and intended use

components.description_pt: Explorar fenômenos cotidianos como evidência de propriedades físicas específicas de materiais
components.description_en: Explore everyday phenomena as evidence of specific physical properties of materials
components.cc_component_description: Observe and measure physical properties such as density, solubility, and conductivity to identify materials

cc_matches.description: Measurements of a variety of properties can be used to identify materials. (Boundary: At this grade level, mass and weight are not distinguished, and no attempt is made to define the unseen particles or explain the atomic-scale mechanism of evaporation and condensation.)
Structures can be designed to serve particular functions by taking into account properties of different materials, and how materials can be shaped and used.
Make observations and measurements to identify materials based on their properties.
